authority: Owner instruction, 2026-09-13: enriched abstracts and other metadata must be visible in public paper sheets.
semantics: A derived public display of existing support, not a new scientific state. Candidate IDs are joined exactly; the bibliography snapshot detects mixed release generations. Existing reading-aid kinds are preserved. Synopses are short paraphrases, never labelled as original abstracts. Abstract availability is distinct from copied text; full-text locators are distinct from open-access assessments. Resolver DOI does not overwrite registered DOI. All notes, reviewers, evidence quotations, copied abstract/full-text bodies and private scientific proposals are excluded. The generated artifact is rebuilt on release and compared field-by-field with the HTTP-served artifact, independently of register counts. No new scientific class, enum or canonical identity is introduced.
